notes_for_editor: Sources disagree: lightship date (Board reports 1900, Lighthouse Friends 1901); Indiana Harbor collision 1993 (Lighthouse Friends) vs 1995 (Pepper); lens replacement 1976 (Pepper, implied) vs 1985 (owners); 1940 winds 126 mph (Pepper) vs log 80 mph. Cost $261,765 vs about $262,000. Sources 5, 6, 11 are modern secondary pages; the 1908 Board request, the 1940 log and the 1929 ice storm are known only as they report them (no primary check; the 1908 report is not in the corpus). The 1900 and 1901 Light-House Board volumes have no page index, so footnotes give no page. Lightship crew names come from Bulletin OCR text (Berutsen's first name is an OCR reading). USLHS roster: Floyd W. Miller appears on three lines (1946-49 first assistant, 1950s head keeper), roster lines with blank ends kept as printed; USCG crew 1960-1974 are roster entries only, not named in prose. Keller's four ranks come from separate roster lines. Bulletin 1928 name of steamer 'Sonora' from Lighthouse Friends; the OCR reads 'Sonot'a'. NRHP nomination PDF is not digitised at NPS; lansingshoals.org cites it (prepared by Karmen Bisher, 3 May 2005). Also: owners' history puts LV55's arrival after 19 July 1900 (Simmons Reef buoy), the Board 10 July 1900. Bulletin 1928 gives no year for the 8 July / 4 August collisions beyond its 1928 volume. Footnotes 14-16 cite PDF pages (verified against the PDFs).
